compatibilityAssertions: Every version 1 manifest keeps parsing with the current schema; new fields stay optional.
A page opens from disk: the manifest is embedded in index.html and the viewer is a classic script, not a module.
Paths in a manifest stay inside media/, and links are http or https only.
Notes and tags appear only when the export chose to include them.
No Library id, file path, Inbox state, rating, or list kind appears in a manifest.
